reasons: Rule applies: the Agreement's General Provisions (p0063–p0073) contain no insurance clause, and Kubient is a hosting vendor that per p0035 collects, maintains and stores visitor data, so the preferred coverages are warranted.

The inserted paragraph tracks the playbook model language (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, certificates on request) and adds only statutory workers' compensation, which the preferred position expressly contemplates; the obligation runs against Kubient only and no existing text is altered.

Placement is appropriate — appended at the end of the General Provisions after the final subsection (i) — and the edit is additive, so the changed-character ratio is inherent to a missing-clause insert.
Comment is accurate, concise, in our voice, cites the playbook position and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback.

Minor, non-blocking nits: the inserted paragraph omits the '(j)' subsection label referenced in the rationale, and it uses capitalized 'Term' and 'Law' which may not be defined terms in this Agreement — worth conforming at execution but neither changes substance or direction.
